daytonic enters the competition

Quantum is just the universe trading energy in fixed little packets that match specific frequencies, so every particle or field is basically vibrating only at the notes it is allowed to hit, which is why things look like both waves and particles at once. A quantum computer takes one of those vibrations, lets it sit in two energy notes at the same time, then locks several of them together so their phases stay matched and the whole group can try many paths before you read the result. The same control over those quantized vibrations is already used to build sensors that catch tiny signals and materials that move light or heat with less waste, which means computing, measurement, and energy handling are all just different ways of keeping the same clean frequency and phase under control.
